dashboard.title: API Growth & Protection Overview
dashboard.description: Executive MVP view for growth, service health, and protected-vs-served outcomes using Zuplo plugin-baseline fields, Akamai DS2-native correlation, and transform-derived dimensions only.

options.content:
## API Growth & Protection Overview
Growth, health, and protection posture from the MVP-safe overview summary. `unknown` and `none` values are expected fallbacks when optional auth or Akamai security context is sparse.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Claim: traffic volume is rising or stable. Evidence: merged request count from the 1-minute overview summary. Provenance: summary over transform-derived and plugin-baseline fields only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  countMerge(`count()`) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Requests; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Distinct Consumers
panels.description: Claim: the MVP still captures useful audience breadth without billing or tenant tags. Evidence: merged unique consumer surrogate count. Provenance: `consumer_id` comes from plugin-baseline `userSub`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  uniqMerge(`uniq(consumer_id)`) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Distinct Consumers; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Protected Share %
panels.description: Claim: edge and gateway controls are meaningfully intercepting hostile traffic. Evidence: rate-limited, auth-rejected, and policy-denied outcomes over all requests. Provenance: transform-derived outcome categories with `unknown` tolerated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome IN ('rate_limited', 'auth_rejected', 'policy_denied'))
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Protected Share; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Gateway Error Rate %
panels.description: Claim: service health remains separate from protective controls. Evidence: gateway-error outcome share. Provenance: transform-derived `gateway_outcome` from response status and optional policy context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'gateway_error')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Gateway Error Rate; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Request Volume Trend
panels.description: Claim: growth should be visible across 1h, 6h, and 7d windows. Evidence: merged request counts at the summary's native 1-minute grain. Provenance: overview summary only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Request Volume Trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Gateway p95 Latency
panels.description: Claim: performance degradation should surface before analysts drill deeper. Evidence: merged p95 gateway latency over time. Provenance: transform-derived `gateway_latency_ms` summarized at 1 minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0) AS p95_latency_ms
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Gateway p95 Latency; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Route Groups
panels.description: Claim: route concentration and protection posture identify where growth is landing. Evidence: request volume, protected share, and p95 latency by route group. Provenance: overview summary dimensions only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  route_group,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests,
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome IN ('rate_limited', 'auth_rejected', 'policy_denied'))
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS protected_pct,
  round(ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0), 1) AS p95_latency_ms
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND route_group != 'unknown'
GROUP BY route_group
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Top Route Groups; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Gateway Outcome Mix
panels.description: Claim: the protected-vs-served story should be readable in one glance. Evidence: outcome mix over the selected window. Provenance: transform-derived `gateway_outcome` with expected fallback buckets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  gateway_outcome,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY gateway_outcome
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Overview Gateway Outcome Mix; du=${__user.login}'
